predictions.why: Under the mechanism a self-opened plain answer has entered the self-checking register and is as robust at T 1.0 as a cued answer on the same problems (D = 0.00, AUROC 0.54 says the ~332 non-self-opened problems are of near-average difficulty), so the ~168 stored self-opened rows (~0.82, ~138 right) plus ~332 rejection-sampled self-opened continuations at cued-level accuracy (~0.81, slightly lowered by the longer plain register's extra cap hits, R = 1.21) give about the cued 410, a little below.
